tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// ston pa mchog dang 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po bcu drug 'khor bcas mchod cing gsol ba dang smon lam gdab pa'i cho ga byang chub chen po'i spyod pa rab tu rgyas pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

mnyam med zas gtsang sras sogs sangs rgyas dang*// rgyal sras thu bo nyan thos tshul bzung nas// dam chos skyong ba gnas brtan bcu drug sogs// rgyal ba sras dang bcas la phyag bgyi'o// bdag cag gi ston pa shākya'i rgyal po dang 'phags pa'i gnas brtan 'khor bcas mchod cing gsol ba gdab pa la/ sngon gyi phyag bzhes rnams su/ rang gzhan gyi sdig pa sbyong ba/ 'jig rten du chos kyi bshad nyan dang bstan pa dar ba/ rang rgyud la bslab pa gsum skye ba ste gsol ba 'debs pa'i thabs gsum dang*/ sku gzugs ji ltar bya ba/ maṇḍal dang*/ gtor ma dang*/ mchod pa la brten te cho ga bya ba'i khyad par gsum/ bsod nams 'phel ba'i phyir gnas brtan rnams spyan drangs pa'i thabs sogs yod cing so sor phan yon dgos khyad du ma dang ldan pa las/ 'dir lung rtogs kyi bstan pa dang dge 'dun 'phel pa'i dgos don gtso bo byas/ rang gzhan la 'di dang gtan gyi phan bde 'byung bar gsol ba gdab pa'i phyir/ dus bzang mchod pa lta bur bya sla ba'i dbang du byas te/ gtsug lag khang la sogs pa'i gnas byi dor byas pa'i gud du dkon mchog spyi'i rten dang*/ khyad par shākya seng ge dang gnas brtan 'khor bcas kyi sku gzugs bkram pa'i mdun/ stegs gtsang mar dri bzang gis byugs pa'i maṇḍal rgyas par na/ gtso bo gnas brtan bcu drug dharma tā bcas la bco brgyad dang*/ de re rer yang padma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i lte bar tshom bu re re 'god par gsungs kyang*/ ma 'byor na/ maṇḍal la rdul tshon sogs kyis padma 'dab ma bcu drug pa bris pa'i dbus su 'bras sam nas kyi tshom bu gcig dang*/ 'dab ma re la tshom bu re bkod pa'i mtha' bskor du gtsang zhing bzang ba'i mchod pa ci 'byor dang*/ dung chos sam dngul gyi bya ma bum lta bur rdzas bdun ldan pa'i mchod yon dang sbreng ba'i bzed zhal/ chu gtsang gi zhabs bsil la dūrba'i chun po me tog gis bcings pa bcas/

rkang rten chol zangs kyi rnam pa/ rin po che'i khrus bum/ dūrba'i pir/ nye shing sran dkar sug pa sogs sbyar ba'i 'dag chal/ khrus ras kā shi ka /gos zung ngur smrig /nyer spyod lnga/ khyad par du snga dro'i char dus su rung ba/ tsā ru'i bza' ba lha bshos rgyan dang ldan pa sogs zan/ 'bras chan/ lde gu/ dkar gsum/ khur ba ste bza' ba lnga dang*/ rtsa ba/ sdong bu/ lo ma/ me tog /'bras bu ste bca' ba lnga/ phyi dro'i char rgun 'brum la sogs pa'i khu ba/ chur khu/ zho kha chu/ bzang ja tsab mo sogs thun tshod du rung ba'i btung ba brgyad rung chu gtsang ma btab pa/ bu ram/ ka ra/ sbrang rtsi/ mngar gsum gyi ting khrol/ 'bru mar sogs zhag bdun pa'i sman/ bzang po drug sogs 'tsho bcang gi sman rnams dang*/ dus nges med du 'bul rung ba/ bla bre 'phan gdugs rgyal mtshan/ chos gos rnam gsum sogs 'tsho ba'i yo byad/ lhung bzed/ 'khar gsil/ spyi blugs/ gri gu/ khab/ rig pa'i gnas lnga'i glegs bam dang*/ de la nye bar mkho ba tshon pir/ sman sna/ sa gzhong*/ rdul byang*/ snag smyug shog bu sogs mkho ba'i yo byad/ 'dod yon lnga/ rgyal srid sna bdun/ bkra shis rtags rdzas/ rin chen sman 'bru dri dang snying po ste lnga phrag lnga bcas/ nyer spyod nas 'di yan 'byor ba rab kyis tshar bco brgyad re 'am/ nus pa ma bsris par bsham/ de dag gi mdun du dkon mchog spyi la cog zlum rgyan ldan gcig /rgyal chen bzhi la dkar gtor bzhi 'am gcig /stegs cung dma' bar rigs drug la changs bu gtor ma/ gzhi bdag dkar gtor/ cha gsum rnams dkar mngar sogs rang rang la 'os pa'i bza' bca' sna tshogs bcas te bshams/ maṇḍal 'bul ba'i chas dang*/ 'thor nas me tog /rol mo'i rigs 'os pa rnams kyang 'du bya/ bshams bkod de tsam ma 'byor tshe sgrub pa'i rten maṇḍal tshom bu bcu bdun ma dang*/ chu gnyis nyer spyod/ khrus dang maṇḍal chas/ 'bul gtor rnams nges par dgos shing*/

gzhan gang 'dzoms kyis kyang rung*/ sgrub pa po dge slong dge tshul dge bsnyen gang yang rung ba yin na rab/ khyim pa lta bur tshangs spyod kyi dge bsnyen nam/ bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa phog /dgos pa 'ga' zhig gi phyir du gsol ba 'debs pa yin na bkra shis pa'i gso sbyong sngon du btang bas legs pa'i yan lag tu 'gyur ro// cho ga dngos la sbyor ba skyabs sems byin rlabs/ dngos gzhi spyan 'dren tshogs bsags/ rjes kyi las rim bcas yod pa las thog mar sbyor ba skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la skyabs su mchi'o// ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma kun khyab chos kyi sku la skyabs su mchi'o// ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma bde chen longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la skyabs su mchi'o// ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma thugs rje sprul pa'i sku la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes lan bdun nam nyer gcig sogs skabs dang bstun par bya zhing*/ spro na/ rgyu sbyor pa sbyin pa'i bdag pos thog drangs nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i bdag nyid chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag /drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o// chos la skyabs su mchi'o// dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes skyabs su song nas gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog

/ ces lan gsum gyis sems bskyed pa gsal gdab/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dam pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms chen po la gnas par gyur cig / ces lan gsum gyis tshad med bzhi bsgom/ gsum pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ byin rlabs dang*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mthu dang*/ chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin gyi yon tan dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su sbyangs pa'i mthu dang*/ bdag cag rnams kyi mos pa'i mthu las gnas 'dir sa gzhi rin po che sna bdun pa'i rang bzhin lag mthil ltar mnyam pa tha gru che zhing yangs pa/ reg na 'jam zhing bde ba/ lha'i me tog dri zhim pos gcal bkram pa/ yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chu'i mtsho dang rdzing bu dang lteng ka rin po che'i phye ma gram bur gdal zhing nor bu'i pha gus mtha' brtsigs pa/ utpal dang ku muta dang padma du mas mdzes pa dang*/ chu bya skad snyan par sgrog pa mang pos gang ba rnams dang*/ rin po che'i shing ljon pa sna tshogs rnam par rgyas pa la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rgyan dang*/ bkod pa dang yon tan phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang ldan par gyur cig /de'i dbus su gzhal med khang chen po rin po che sna bdun mchog tu 'bar ba bkod pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams dpag tu med pa rgyas par 'gengs pa'i 'od zer chen po rab tu 'byung ba/ gnas tha dad pa shin tu rnam par phye ba mtha' yas pa rnam par gnas pa/ rgya yongs su ma chad pa/ khams gsum las yang dag par 'das pa'i spyod yul/ 'jig rten las yang dag par 'das pa de'i bla ma'i dge ba'i rtsa ba las byung ba/

shin tu rnam par dag cing dbang sgyur ba'i rnam par rig pa'i mtshan nyid/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas/ byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang ldan pa/ lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang dri za dang lha ma yin dang nam mkha' lding dang mi 'am ci dang lto 'phye chen po dang mi dang mi ma yin pa mtha' yas pa rnam par rgyu ba/ chos kyi ro'i dga' ba dang bde ba chen pos brtan pa/ sems can thams cad kyi don thams cad yang dag par thob par byed pas nye bar gnas pa/ nyon mongs pa'i gnod pa'i dri ma thams cad dang bral ba/ bdud thams cad yongs su spangs pa/ thams cad kyi bkod pa las lhag pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i bkod pa'i gnas/ dran pa blo gros dang rtogs pa chen pos nges par 'byung ba/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi bzhon pa yin pa/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang*/ mtshan ma med pa nyid dang*/ smon pa med pa nas 'jug pa/ rin po che padma'i rgyal po yon tan mtha' yas pas brgyan pa'i bkod pa la brten pa'i gzhal med khang chen por gyur/ de'i dbus su lha dang klu dang mi la sogs pa'i rin po che sna tshogs pa'i khri'i steng du lha mi'i gos rin thang med pa bting ba'i steng du/ gtsang zhing dri ma med pa'i padma'i gdan sna tshogs pa bshams pa so sor gsal bar gyur/ khri de dag gi steng du rin po che sna tshogs dang lha dang mi'i gos sna tshogs las grub pa'i gdugs dang bla re sa dang 'phan dang lda ldi dang lha'i me tog man dā ra ba la sogs pa rnams kyi char dang*/ bla res dang gdugs dang 'phan dang*/ lda ldi la sogs pa mdzes par bres shing*/ logs rnams kyang rin po che dang*/ dar dang me tog la sogs pa'i dra ba dang dra phyed dang 'phan dang lda ldi la sogs pas mdzes pa dang*/ sa gzhir lha dang mi'i me tog sil ma bkram zhing*/ mchod yon me tog gdug spos mar me dri chab zhal zas rol mo la sogs pa phung po gsum pa'i mdo dang bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam las 'byung ba lta bu'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi rgya mtsho phul du byung zhing sna tshogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa nam mkha'i khams kyi mtha' klas par rgyas par gang zhing zad mi shes pa dang ldan par gyur/

de dag thun mong du byin gyis brlab pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ byin rlabs dang tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mthu dang*/ chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin gyi yon tan dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su sbyangs pa'i mthu dang*/ bdag cag rnams kyi mos pa'i mthu las de de bzhin tu gyur cig / lan gsum mam bsdu na tshar gcig bzlas/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi las spyan 'dren pa ni dge 'dun rnams 'greng pa'am pus btsug thal mo sbyar la spos thogs/ me tog bkram ste/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya'i dbang po la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po bcu drug dge bsnyen dharma tā nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa rgyal po chen po bzhi 'khor bcas sogs dam pa'i chos skyong ba'i zhabs 'bring rgya mtshos yongs su bskor ba thams cad/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi nyes ltung gi dri ma sbyang zhing bsod nams kyi tshogs spel pa'i slad du spyan 'dren zhing mchis na thugs rje chen pos bskul te deng dus la bab kyis dgongs par mdzad du gsol// zhes dang*/ kye don thams cad grub pa 'dir gshegs su gsol/ kye lha'i lha/ kye kha lo sgyur ba/ kye dga' zhing bde ba dang mchog tu dga' bar mdzad pa/ kye sman pa bla na med pa'i grags pa mnga' ba/ kye kun nas spyan mnga' ba/ kye mi mnyam pa dang mnyam zhing 'gran zla med pa'i yon tan dang gzi brjid mnga' ba/ mtshan dang dpe byad bzang pos yang dag par brgyan pa'i sku mnga' ba 'dir gshegs su gsol/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/

bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru// 'gro la brtse phyir thugs rje rnam sbyangs shing*// smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa'i// khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags na// de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas// rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing*// mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir// yongs bdag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol// chos rnams kun gyi dbang phyug gtso// btso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra zhing*// nyi ma las lhag gzi brjid che// dad pas spyan ni drangs bar bgyi// zhi zhing thugs rje che ldan pa// dul zhing bsam gtan sa la bzhugs// chos dang ye shes chags bral ba// kun tu mi bzad nus par ldan// tshur spyon tshur spyon zhi dag lha// thub pa skyes mchog thams cad mkhyen// shin tu legs byas gzugs brnyan ni// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// zhes dang*/ tshul khrims rnam dag shes rab shin tu dag /dad ldan snying po nyan thos che rnams kyis// mgon med gyur pa bdag la rjes bzung pa'i// don mdzad thugs rjes dgongs par mdzad du gsol// zhes dang*/ lag mthil ltar mnyam rin chen rgyan gyis spras// ljon shing chu mtshos brgyan pa'i sa gzhi'i dbus// rin chen las grub gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa// padma nyi zlas brgyan pa'i gdan steng du// thugs rjes rtsod pa'i dus kyi gdul bya rnams// rnam grol lam la 'god mdzad 'gro ba'i mgon// thub pa mchog dang gnas brtan chen po rnams// 'khor dang bcas pa gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad dang*// shes rab me 'bar nyon mongs mtsho skem zhing*// rnam grol bsod nams zhing du bkas sdod pa'i// phyogs bcu'i nyan thos dge 'dun bzhugs so 'tshal// yon sbyong mchod pa'i gnas su spyan 'dren gyis// 'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol// 'gro ba'i mgon po shākya seng ge yi// sangs rgyas bstan pa gang gis phyag tu bzhugs// gsung rab rin chen sgrom gyi kha 'byed pa'i// dgra bcom gnas brtan chen po bzhugs so 'tshal// dam chos spel pa'i slad du spyan 'dren na// 'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol// thub pas bka' bgos bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin// yan lag 'byung dang ma pham nags na gnas// dus ldan rdo rje mo'i bu bzang po dang*// gser be'u bha ra dhwa dza gser chen mchog

/'phags pa ba ku la dang sgra gcan 'dzin// lam phran bha ra dhwa dza bsod snyoms len// lam brtan klu'i sde sbed byed mi phyed pa// 'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol// spangs dang ye shes phun tshogs sangs rgyas kyang*// gdul bya'i dbang gis nyan thos tshul 'dzin cing*// khyad par can gyi phrin las chos skyong pa'i// gnas brtan bcu drug 'dir spyon gdan la bzhugs// bde gshegs bka' lung gtsor mdzad bstan pa srung*// rang don dor nas 'khor pa'i nags tshal du// gzhan don lhur mdzad gnas brtan bcu drug po// dam bcas thugs rje'i dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs// dge bsnyen skyabs gsol bden pa'i tshig nyan pa// dkon mchog gsum gyi zhabs 'bring mchis so 'tshal// bsod nams rin chen gling du spyan 'dren na// 'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol//

zhes spos btul/ me tog gtor/ rol mo bcas spyan drangs la bzhugs gsol ni/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// zhes dang*/ rin chen du ma las grub seng ge'i khri// yid 'phrog sna tshogs gos kyis bkab pa 'di// sangs rgyas sras dang bcas la phul ba yis// 'gro kun rdo rje'i gdan la 'khod par shog /stong gsum kun dang mnyam pa yi// padma 'dab brgyad ge sar bcas// bde zhing yangs par 'bul lags na// ci bde bar ni bzhugs su gsol// bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir// nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni// ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid pa// de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol// mchod yon gyi chu bzed zhal du sbrengs la/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang*// sems can lus ngag yid gsum gdung ba sel slad du// yan lag brgyad ldan chu gtsang yid du 'ong ba 'di// bzhes shig bzhes shig bdag gi mchod yon 'di dag go// btung ba phul ba'i bsod nams kyis// nyon mongs bkres skom zhi ba dang*// sbyin sogs yon tan ldan pa yi// skom dad med par skye bar shog / chu dūrba'i chun pos blangs te chol zangs su zhabs bkru ba'i tshul bya zhing*/ ngang pa'i mchog ltar sor mo dra bas 'brel// 'khor lo'i mtshan can mdzes pa'i zhabs zung la// dag byed phul bas skye bo ma lus pa/ rdzu 'phrul rkang pa mchog dang ldan gyur cig / khrus gsol ni/ phyag len mthong brgyud ltar byas la/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa bde bar gshegs pa 'jig rten mkhyen pa skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo bsgyur ba bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa'i dge 'dun 'khor dang bcas pa la bdag gis yo byad thams cad dang ldan pa'i khrus 'di gsol bar bgyi'o//

zhes snyan gsan nas khrus khang bskyed pa ni/ khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa// shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher ba bstar// rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan// mu tig 'od chags bla re bres pa der// dri dang bcas pa'i 'dag chal dūrbas byug cing*/ stong gsum kun tu dri ngad ldang pa yi// dri mchog rnams kyis thub dbang rnams kyi sku// gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar// 'od chags 'bar ba de dag byug par bgyi// khrus gsol zhing*/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kun gyis khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan// thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med// byin rlabs ye shes chu yis ni// ci 'dod dngos grub stsal du gsol// rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang*// sems can lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa sbyang slad du// rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la khrus chab 'di gsol bas// sems can lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa dag gyur cig / spro na de dag re re la'ang thog mar 'dag chal skam phye dang snum thigs dang bcas pa'i chus bsgos pa'i dūrbas byugs pa dag /mjug tu skam phye snum thigs dang bcas pas bsgos pa'i khrus ras dkar pos sku phyi zhing*/ rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kyi sku rnams la// ras dkar sman dang ldan pas sku phyi bas// mi shes sgrib pa ma lus kun bsal nas// nyes pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus dag gyur cig / yang stong gsum kun tu sogs 'dag chal sngon du 'gro bas/ de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sras rnams la// rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chus// yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni// rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol// sku phyi zhing*/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bgos bas sku phyi'o//

gos zung ngur smrig 'bul zhing*/ de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i// na bza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa 'bul// gos bzang srab la 'jam pa sna tshogs dang*// rgyan mchog brgya phrag de dang de dag gis// 'phags pa kun tu bzang dang 'jam dbyangs dang*// 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs la'ang brgyan par bgyi// sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra zhing*// gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i// gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyang phyir 'bul// bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog / ces spyan 'dren yan lag bcas song nas/ tshogs bsags pa la gsum las/ thog mar yan lag bdun pa'i sgo nas bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'i dang po phyag 'tshal ba ni/ 'greng ste gnas lnga sa la btud pa dang bcas/ bla ma mnyam med sangs rgyas rin po che// dus gsum bde gshegs sras bcas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin byin brlabs pa// bka' drin chen po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba ma lus dang*// byang chub sems dang rgyal sras ma lus tshogs// rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed bzhugs pa yi// bla med 'phags pa'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags pa sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo las spyan ras gzigs dang mthu chen thob kyis bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa/ gzi brjid mtshungs med yon tan phung po gcig la phyag 'tshal lo// drang srong chen po kun mkhyen yon tan kun gyi pha rol gshegs// thams cad zil gnon srid pa gsum gyi chags pa'i lam las 'das// shākya'i khyu mchog dri bral zla ba'i zhal la phyag 'tshal lo// yang mdo las/ gang gis 'ching rnams yang dag rab bcad cing*// mu stegs tshogs rnams thams cad nges bcom ste// sde dang bcas pa'i bdud ni btul nas /ri yi rgyal po gangs can la// 'phags pa gnas brtan mi phyed pa// dgra bcom stong phrag gcig gis bskor// byang chen mchod rten 'dzin phyag 'tshal// bstan pa= /'phags pa'i dge bsnyen dharma tā// ral pa'i thod bcings glegs bam khur// snang ba mtha' yas mdun na bzhugs// rnga g.yab bum pa 'dzin phyag 'tshal// bstan pa= /brtson pas go bgos mthu stobs can// sangs rgyas bstan pa legs skyong ba'i// shar lho nub byang phyogs bzhi yi// rgyal chen bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo// bstan pa rgyas par byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa tsam mam/ spro na mkhan chen mchims dang spyan snga thams cad mkhyen pa sogs kyis mdzad pa'i bstod rnying byin rlabs can rnams kyis kyang phyag 'bul bar bya'o/ /mchod pa'i yan lag nyer spyod nas bstod pa'i bar bcu gsum po rim bzhin 'bul ba'i dang po nyer spyod ni/ mdzes pa'i me tog 'di phul bas// mi mdzes skyon kun dag gyur te// mtshan dang dpe byad yongs rdzogs nas// byang chub yan lag rgyas gyur cig /dri zhim bdug spos 'di phul bas// 'chal pa'i dri ma dag gyur te// zag med dri dang ldan gyur nas// ye shes phung po lnga thob shog /snang gsal sgron me 'di phul bas// shes bya'i sgrib pa kun byang nas// ye shes snang ba'i rang bzhin gyis// spyan lnga yongs su dag gyur cig /mchog tu legs sbyar dri phul bas// 'chal ba'i shes rab dag gyur te// shes bya ma lus mkhyen pa yi// shes rab phun sum tshogs par shog /zhal zas ro mchog 'di phul bas// 'gro drug srid pa dag gyur te// bsam gtan ting 'dzin zas mchog ldan// gnyis su med pa'i don rtogs shog /mdzes pa'i rol mo 'di phul bas// chos brgyad 'dzin pa dag gyur te// zab mo'i gdams pa la brten nas// du ma ro gcig rtogs par shog / gnyis pa 'dod yon ni/ rgyal ba zag med 'byor ba mnga' bsgyur yang*// 'gro ba'i don du 'dod yon rnam lnga yis// mchod pas mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyis// bsod nams mi zad gter la spyod par shog

/ gsum pa rgyal srid ni/ mi dbang rin chen sna bdun 'di dag ni// sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa ma lus la// bshams shing yid kyis dmigs te phul ba yis// 'gro ba mi zad gter la spyod par shog / bzhi pa rdzas rtags ni/ rin chen gdugs dang gser nya padma dung*// bum pa rgyal mtshan dpal be'u 'khor lo ste// lha yi dga' tshal mdzes par byed pa yi// bkra shis rtags brgyad dag ni dbul par bgyi// lha yi dbang po lha min g.yul rgyal nas// bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyis mchod ba ltar// rgyal ba rnams dang byang chub sems dpa' la// bkra shis rdzas brgyad dag gis mchod par bgyi// lnga pa mdzes byed drug ni/ theg mchog bla bres gdugs dang ba dan dang*// bdud bcom rgyal mtshan lhab lhub ting 'dzin 'phan// gar dang rol mo mchod pa'i sgra dbyangs kyis// rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mdzes par brgyan par bgyi// drug pa maṇḍal ni/ oṃ badzra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badzra sa twa twe no pa/ tiṣṭha dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su toṣyo me bha wa/ su poṣyo me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ sarba siddhi mme pra yatstsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsittaṃ shre yaḥ ku ru hūm̐ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān sarba ta thā ga ta badzra mā me muñtsa badzrī bha wa ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ zhes yi ge brgya pa brjod bzhin maṇḍal gyi rdul g.yas bskor du phyi/ me tog gi tshom bu phyag bzhes ltar 'god bzhin/ oṃ badzra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi rnam par dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ oṃ badzra re khe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri'i khor yug gi ra bas yongs su bskor ba'i dbus su ri yi rgyal po ri bo mchog rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho dzam bu gling*/ nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ lus dang lus 'phags/ rnga yab dang rnga yab gzhan/ g.yo ldan dang lam mchog 'gro/ sgra mi snyan dang sgra mi snyan gyi zla/ rin po che'i ri bo/ dpag bsam gyi shing*/

'dod 'jo'i ba/ ma rmos pa'i lo tog /'khor lo rin po che/ nor bu rin po che/ btsun mo rin po che/ blon po rin po che/ glang po rin po che/ rta mchog rin po che/ dmag dpon rin po che/ gter chen po'i bum pa/ sgeg mo ma/ phreng ba ma/ glu ma/ gar ma/ me tog ma/ bdug spos ma/ snang gsal ma/ dri chab ma/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ rin po che'i gdugs/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal pa'i rgyal mtshan/ dbus su lha dang mi yi dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i rdul gyi grangs las 'das pa mngon par bkod de/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la dbul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes dang*/ sa gzhi spos chus byugs shing me tog bkram// ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di// sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis// 'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog /

me tog 'bras bu ji snyed yod pa dang*// sman gyi rnam pa gang dag yod pa dang*// 'jig rten rin chen ji snyed yod pa dang*// chu gtsang yid du 'ong ba ci yod dang*// rin chen ri bo dang ni de bzhin dkon mchog thams cad dang*// mchod rten rnams dang sku gzugs la// rin chen me tog la sogs char// rgyun mi 'chad par 'bab par shog /ji ltar 'jam dbyangs la sogs pas// rgyal ba rnams la mchod mdzad pa// ༈ /sems can rnams la brtse ba can// phrad dang bral ba'i dgongs pa can// mi 'bral ba yi dgongs pa can// phan bde dgongs khyod la phyag 'tshal// thub pa sgrib kun nges par grol// 'jig rten thams cad zil gyis gnon// khyod kyi mkhyen pas shes bya khyab// thugs grol khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// sems can dag ni thams cad kyi// nyon mongs ma lus thams cad 'dul// nyon mongs 'joms mdzad nyon mongs la// brtse bcas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// lhun gyis grub cing chags mi mnga'// thogs pa mi mnga' rtag par ni// mnyam par bzhag cing dri kun gyi// lan ldon khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rten dang brten pa bshad bya dang*// gsung dang mkhyen pa 'chad byed la// blo gros rtag thogs mi mnga' ba// legs ston khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// gshegs nas spyod pa mkhyen mdzad de// de dag skad kyis sems can gyi// 'ong dang 'gro dang nges 'byung la// legs 'doms khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// lus can kun gyis khyod mthong na// skyes bu dam pa lags par 'tshal// mthong ba tsam gyis rab dang bar// mdzad pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// len dang gnas dang gtong ba dang*// sprul dang yongs su sgyur ba dang*// ting nge 'dzin dang ye shes la// mnga' brnyes khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// thabs dang skyobs dang dag pa dang*// theg chen nges par 'byung ba la// sems can rnams la rab slu ba'i// bdud 'joms khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rang gzhan don du ye shes dang*// spangs dang nges 'byung bgegs mdzad par// ston mdzad mu stegs gzhan dag gis// mi brdzi khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// bsrung med bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba// 'khor gyi nang na bag brkyang gsung*// kun nas nyon mongs gnyis spangs la// 'khor sdud khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// kun mkhyen khyod la rgyu ba dang*// gnas pa kun la rtag par ni// kun mkhyen min spyod mi mnga' ste// yang dag don ldan khyod phyag 'tshal// sems can kun gyi bya ba la// khyod ni dus las mi 'da' bas/

mdzad pa rtag tu don mnga' ba// mi bsnyel khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jig rten kun la nyin mtshan du// lan drug tu ni so sor gzigs// thugs rje chen po dang ldan dang*// phan dgongs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// spyod pa dang ni rtogs pa dang*// ye shes dang ni phrin las kyis// nyan thos rang sangs rgyas kun gyi// bla ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// sku gsum dag gi byang chub che// rnam pa kun brnyes thams cad du// sems can kun gyi the tshom dag /gcod pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dzin pa mi mnga' nyes mi mnga'// rnyog pa mi mnga' mi gnas pa// mi g.yo chos rnams thams cad la// spros med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba ma lus dang*// byang chub sems dang rgyal sras ma lus tshogs// rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed bzhugs pa yi// bla med 'phags pa'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'gro ba'i nyon mongs thams cad zhi mdzad cing*// mi khom gnas su dkon mchog gsum sgra sgrog /'phags pa rgyal sras sgra gcan 'dzin la sogs// gnas brtan chen po rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// gzhan yang lha mi la sogs 'jig rten na// bde gshegs slob ma dang ni sras gyur pa// mchod 'os yon tan zhing du gang gyur pa// de dag yon tan dang bas bstod par bgyi// bstod par 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu// mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal bstod// mchod pa de rnams kyi bar mtshams gang 'os su bsod nams cher 'phel ba'i phyir mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs sngags 'di'ang brjod do// na mo bha ga wa te badzra sā ra pra marda ni/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arha te samyaksaṃ buddhu ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ badzre badzre ma hā badzre/ ma hā te dzo badzre/ ma hā bidyā badzre/ ma hā bo dhi tsitta badzre/ ma hā bo dhi maṇṭo pa saṃ kra ma ṇa badzre/ sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha na badzre swā hā/

de nas bshags pa sogs kyi yan lag lhag ma rnams ni/ spro na ltung bshags dang*/ bdag cag rnams kyis thog ma ma mchis pa nas 'khor ba na 'khor ba'i tshe rabs thams cad du sdig pa mi dge ba'i las mdor na mi bgyi bar 'os pa'i las ni bgyis/ bgyi bar 'os pa'i las ni ma bgyis pa la sogs pa dngos sdig ci mchis pa thams cad yang dag par 'chags so// dus gsum gyi 'phags pa dang so so skye bo'i dge ba mtha' dag gi bsod nams thams cad la rjes su yi rang ngo*// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo bla na med pa bskor bar bskul lo// 'jig rten gyi sgron ma gang dag mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul ston par bzhed pa de dag thams cad mya ngan las mi 'da' bar 'jig rten gyi don mdzad cing yun ring du bzhugs par gsol bar 'tshal lo// ston pa bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa dang*// 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po bcu drug 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs te phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ mchod cing de dag gi smon lam btab pa dang*/ de dag gi spyan sngar sdig pa bshags pa dang*/ dge ba la rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul zhing mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba btab pa dang*/ de dag gi mthu dpal dang byin gyi rlabs kyi stobs kyis bdag cag gi thog ma ma mchis pa'i 'khor ba nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig /lus la nad med pa dang tshe ring bar gyur cig /'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dpal phun sum tshogs pa la mnga' brnyes par gyur cig /mthar tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs nas rdo rje'i sku chos kyi rgyal po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi go 'phang brnyes par gyur cig /yul khams thams cad du'ang mi nad dang phyugs nad dang lo nyes pa dang dgra'i gnod pa la sogs pa bkra mi shis pa'i bag ci yang mi 'byung bar gyur cig /char chu dus su babs te lo phyugs 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*/

bde skyid kyi dpal phun sum tshogs dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad kyang bde ba dang ldan sdug bsngal dang bral te tshogs gnyis rdzogs te sangs rgyas par gyur cig /khyad par du yang dam pa'i chos yun ring du gnas shing rgyas par gyur cig /dge 'dun thams cad kyang chos spyod bcu dang 'khor lo gnyis la sogs pa sgo gsum dge ba'i bya ba kho na la nyin mtshan thams cad du brtson par gyur cig /dge 'dun mthun zhing dge 'dun gyi don thams cad 'grub par gyur cig /'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs dbyar gyi chu bo bzhin du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig / de nas dge 'dun 'du ba'i don kho na yin na smon lam 'di'ang gdab/ dus rgyun mi dgos/ rgyal ba sras bcas kun gyi thugs rje dang*// 'jig rten skye dgu'i bsod nams dpag med kyi// bden pa chen po'i nus pa tshad med pas// dge 'dun thams cad gnas 'dir 'du gyur cig /gadgā'i klung gi bye ma'i grangs las kyang*// lhag par 'phags pa'i tshogs kyis rab gtams te// yon tan rgya mtsho'i dpal la spyod pa yi// dge 'dun thams cad= /thos pa rnam par dag pa'i zla ba la// bsam sgom zung du 'jug pa'i 'od zer 'phro// bde stong dbyer med bsil ba'i rol pa can/ dge 'dun thams cad= /a sogs dbyangs kyi brjod pa du ma la// thig le tsheg drag gri gug la sogs pa'i// dbye bas phye ba'i yi ge phreng ba 'dzin// dge 'dun thams cad= /gzhal med khang drug bkod pa'i rgyal po las// rab tu 'bab pa 'dus pa'i chu bo las// lung dang rigs pa'i rlabs phreng g.yo ba can// dge 'dun thams cad= /'di ni 'phags pa 'du ba'i gzhi yin zhes// skye dgu kun gyis mngon par bstod byed pa// grags ldan zhing 'dir 'dren pa dam par bsngags// mthun rkyen mngon par dar ba nyid du shog /rab dkar chos spyod bcu dang dge ba bcu/ mkhas pa'i bya ba gsum dang thos bsam sgom// bslab pa gsum gyi dri bsung rab 'phro ba'i// 'dus pa'i padmo 'dab stong ldan par mdzod// tshul khrims 'od stong 'bar ba'i gzi byin gyis// chos dbyings mkha' la rol pa'i dpal 'byor can// zab gsal dge 'dun nam mkha'i nor bu gang*// gdul bya padmo'i gnyen du bzhad par shog

/lugs gnyis chu bo 'thung ba'i gnyis 'thung gtso// phal rgol dmag dpung bzlog pa'i mtshon cha can// bsod nams rgyal por 'os pa'i dge 'dun gyi// glang po'i mchog de stobs bcu'i bdag por shog /gnas skabs mthar thug rnam pa kun tu yang*// byams dang snying rje'i blo gros zad pa med// gang gā'i rgyun la 'gran pa'i 'byor ba yis// dge 'dun 'phel zhing rgyas ba'i bkra shis shog /

gnyis pa byang chub kyi sems gnyis kyi sgo nas ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa la kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i dbye bas gnyis las dang po la sbyor dngos mjug gsum gyi dang po/ skyabs 'gro dang tshogs bsags ni/ phyag gsum dang pus btsugs thal mo sbyar bas/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi// chos dang byang chub sems dpa' yi// tshogs la'ang de bzhin skyabs su mchi// zhes lan gsum/ yan lag bdun pa rgyas par na spyod 'jug las 'byung ba/ dus gsum gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas kun// chos dang tshogs kyi mchog bcas la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud pas ni bdag phyag 'tshal// byang chub sems kyi gzhi rnams dang*// mchod rten kun la bdag phyag 'tshal// mkhan po de bzhin slob dpon dang*// brtul zhugs mchog la phyag 'tshal lo// gang la sems kyi dam pa rin chen de// skyes pa de yi sku la phyag 'tshal zhing*// gang la gnod pa byas kyang bder 'brel ba// bde ba'i 'byung gnas de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang*/ rin chen sems de gzung bar bya ba'i phyir// zhes pa nas/ mgon po sras dang bcas rnams mchod kyi bar dang*/ bdag ni mi shes gti mug pas// rang bzhin kha na ma tho ba'i// bcas pa'i sdig pa gang yin las// gang yang rung ba bgyis pa rnams// mgon po'i spyan sngar mngon sum du// thal sbyar sdug bsngal 'jigs sems kyis// yang dang yang du phyag 'tshal te// de dag thams cad bshags par bgyi// 'dren pa rnams kyis bdag gi sdig /nongs pa lags par bzung du gsol// 'di ni bzang po ma lags pas// slan chad bdag ni yongs mi bgyid// sems can kun gyi ngan song gi /sdug bsngal ngal gso'i dge ba dang*// sdug bsngal can dag bder gnas la// dga' bas rjes su yi rang ngo*// byang chub rgyur gyur dge bsags pa// de la rjes su yi rang ngo*// lus can 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las// nges par thar la yi rang ngo*// skyob pa rnams kyi byang chub dang*// rgyal sras sa la yi rang ngo*// sems can thams cad phan mdzad pa'i// thugs bskyed dge ba rgya mtsho dang*// sems can phan par mdzad pa la// dga' bas rjes su yi rang ngo*// phyogs rnams kun gyis sangs rgyas la// thal mo sbyar te gsol ba ni// sems can sdug bsngal mun 'thoms la// chos kyi sgron me sbar du gsol// rgyal ba mya ngan 'da' bzhed la// thal mo sbyar te gsol ba ni// 'gro 'di ldong par mi 'god cing*// bskal pa grangs med bzhugs par gsol// de ltar 'di dag kun byas te// dge ba bdag gis bsags pa gang*// des ni sems can thams cad kyi// sdug bsngal thams cad sel bar shog

/ ces dang*/ yang na bzang spyod kyi bdun rnam dag sogs rgyas bsdus gang rigs bya/ dngos gzhi ni/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du/ ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis// byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la// de dag rim bzhin gnas pa ltar// bdag kyang 'gro la phan don du// byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing*// de bzhin du ni bslab pa la'ang*// rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi// lan gsum/ rjes ni/ deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod// mi yi srid pa legs par thob// de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to// rgyal po blon po las dang po'i// ltung ba lnga lnga brgyad la sogs// rtsa ba dang ni yan lag gi /nyes ltung rnams kyis ma gos par// da ni bdag gis ci nas kyang*// rigs dang mthun pa'i las brtsam ste// skyon med btsun pa'i rigs 'di la// rnyog par mi 'gyur de ltar bya// bdag gis de ring skyob pa thams cad kyi// spyan sngar 'gro ba bde gshegs nyid dang ni// bar du bde la mgron du bos zin gyis// lha dang lha min la sogs dga' bar gyis// sogs kyis zab mo lta brgyud pa'i lugs srol 'grub bo// rgya chen spyod brgyud pa ltar na bsam sbyor rang bzhin gsum las/ dang po srid zhi gnyis la mi gnas ba'i byang chub la spro ba bskyed pa'i bsam pa sngon du 'gro bas/ sbyor ba smon 'jug so sor sbyor dngos mjug gsum re yod pa'i smon sbyor gsol gdab ni/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang sa chen po la rab tu bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis dang por bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa de bzhin du bdag

ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed du gsol/ lan gsum/ de nas skyabs 'gro khyad par can ni/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste/ snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// tshogs rnams kyi mchog 'phags pa phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// lan gsum dang tshogs bsags yan lag ni/ ji snyed su dag sogs 'don par bya'o// smon pa'i dngos gzhi ni byams snying rje drag pos/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba skye ba 'di dang skye ba gzhan dang gzhan dag tu sbyin pa'i rang bzhin dang tshul khrims kyi rang bzhin dang sgom pa'i rang bzhin gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba ci bgyis pa dang*/ bgyid du brtsal ba dang*/ bgyid pa la rjes su yi rang ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang sa chen po la rab tu bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed par mdzad pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o// sems can ma brgal ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi'o// ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bgyi'o// dbugs ma phyin pa rnams dbugs dbyung bar bgyi'o// yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las bzla bar bgyi'o//

lan gsum gyis blang*/ smon pa'i rjes ni/ deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod// mi yi srid pa legs par thob// de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to// nyin mtshan dus drug byang sems bsgom// 'gro blos mi spangs tshogs la 'bad// dkar nag chos bzhi blang dor bya// byang sems phan yon mi brjed par// da ni bdag gis ci nas kyang*// rigs dang mthun pa'i las brtsams te// skyon med btsun pa'i rigs 'di la// rnyog par mi 'gyur de ltar bya// bdag gis de ring sogs shlau ka gcig bya'o// 'jug pa byang chub tu sems bskyed ba'i sbyor ba gsol gdab ni/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams las bdag byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blangs ba len par 'tshal gyi de la gnod pa ma mchis na bdag la thugs brtse ba'i slad du cung zad gsan cing stsal bar rigs so// lan gsum/ 'dun pa gso ba ni/ bdag sems can ma brgal ba rnams bsgral ba dang*/ ma grol ba rnams dgrol ba dang*/ dbugs ma phyin pa rnams dbugs dbyung ba dang*/ yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las bzla ba dang*/ sangs rgyas kyis gdung rgyun mi chad par 'dod cing de dag la bdag sems bskyed pa brtan pa dang yi dam brtan par bgyi'o// lan gcig /myur du sbyin par gsol ba ni/ dngos su bshams dang yid kyis sprul// bdag pos yongs su ma bzung dang*// bla na med pa'i mchod pa'i tshogs// ma lus blo yis blangs te 'bul// bdag gis lus dang longs spyod dang*// dus gsum dge ba'i dngos po kun// ma lus dkon mchog spyan sngar 'bul// 'gro ba'i skyabs gyur 'tshang rgya shog /rgyal dang de sras rnams la bdag gis ni// bdag gi lus kun gtan du dbul bar bgyi// sems dpa' mchog rnams bdag ni yongs bzhes shig /gus pas khyed kyi 'bangs su mchi bar bgyi//

zhes dang*/ tsog bur thal mo sbyar te/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bdag la byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blang ba myur du stsal du gsol/ lan gsum brjod/ bar chad dri ba ni/ bla ma las len na don tshan so so nas dri dgos kyang rang gis len tshe/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba byang chub sems dpa' lags shing byang chub tu smon lam btab pa lags te/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa'i gzhi thams cad dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims de dag sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad las blang bar 'tshal lo// zhes brjod cing da ltar byang chub kyi sems skye bar 'gyur ro snyam du dga' ba bsgom/ 'jug pa'i dngos gzhi ni/ sems can gyi don du byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa blangs pa de byang chub ma thob kyi bar du rkyen cis kyang mi 'phrog par bsrung snyam pas pus btsugs thal mo sbyar te/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa dang sa chen po la bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la gsol bar 'tshal te/ de dag gi spyan sngar bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa'i gzhi thams cad dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims thams cad de/ sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ dge ba'i chos sdud pa dang*/ sems can gyi don bya pa'i tshul khrims gang la 'das pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bslabs pa dang*/ ma byon pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bslab par 'gyur ba dang*/ phyogs bcu na da ltar byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad da ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa'i gzhi thams cad dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims thams cad de/ sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ dge ba'i chos sdud pa dang*/ sems can gyi don bya ba'i tshul khrims de thams cad bdag gis yang dag par blang ngo*// lan gsum/ 'jug pa'i rjes chog las/

mkhyen par gsol ba ni/ phyogs bcur phyag bya zhing*/ spos dang me tog phul nas tsog pur 'dug ste/ bdag byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bgyi bas byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blangs pa la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dpang du gyur par phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas mu med pa dag tu bzhugs pa'i 'phags pa'i mchog lkog tu gyur kyang chos thams cad la lkog tu ma gyur pa'i thugs mnga' ba thams cad la mkhyen par gsol lo// zhes lan gsum brjod de phyag bya/ blang pa'i phan yon/ deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod// sogs shlau ka gcig /gsang bar gdams pa dang bslab bya bstan pa/ snod min rnams la gsang bya zhing*// pham 'dra bzhi dang nyes byas sogs// ltung bas ma gos tshul khrims gsum// legs par bsrung ba'i sgo nas ni// da ni bdag gis ci nams kyang*// sogs shlau ka gnyis brjod/ gtang rag gi mchod bstod ni/ ji ltar 'jam dbyangs la sogs pas sogs shlau ka gnyis dang*/ phyag 'tshal ba dang sogs/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid// thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byas nas// skye rga na 'chi rba rlabs 'khrugs pa yi// srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba sgrol bar shog / ces pa rnams kyis 'jug pa'i rjes chog grub bo// gnyis pa don dam byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa ni/ gtso bor mnyam par bzhag pa ni yin mod kyi/ 'dun pa sngon 'gro'i dbang gis dpang kong phyag brgya pa'i mdo'i dgongs pa slob dpon klu'i phyag bzhes jo bo'i chos chung las 'byung ba'i don bsdus/ sbyor dngos mjug gsum las dang po ni/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog mdzad bzhin spyad// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas shog

/ lan gsum/ dngos gzhi ni/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis dngos po thams cad dang bral ba phung po dang khams dang skye mched dang gzung ba dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs pa chos bdag med pa mnyam pa nyid kyi rang gi sems gdod ma nas ma skyes pa stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid kyi byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang dus 'di nas bzung ste// byang chub kyi snying po la mchis kyi bar du dngos po thams cad dang bral ba phung po dang khams dang skye mched dang gzung ba dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs pa chos bdag med pa mnyam pa nyid kyi rang gi sems gdod ma nas ma skyes pa stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid kyi byang chub kyi sems bskyed par bgyi'o// lan gsum/ rjes ni/ bsod nams 'di yis nas/ 'gro ba 'don par bgyi// byang chub sems ni rin po che// ma skyes pa rnams skye gyur cig /skyes pa nyams pa med pa dang*// gong nas gong du 'phel bar shog /byang chub sems dang mi 'bral zhing*// byang chub spyod la gzhol ba dang*// sangs rgyas rnams kyis yongs bzung zhing*// bdud kyi las rnams spong bar shog /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ni// 'gro don thugs la dgongs 'grub shog /mgon po yis ni gang dgongs pa// sems can rnams la de 'byor shog /sems can thams cad bde dang ldan gyur cig /ngan 'gro thams cad rtag tu stongs par shog /byang chub sems dpa' gang dag sar bzhugs pa// de dag kun gyi smon lam 'grub par shog / ces bya/ gsum pa rdzogs smin sbyang gsum gyi byang chen spyod pa dang 'brel bar smon lam gdab pas tshogs bsags pa mthar phyin par yongs su bsngo ba la'ang*/ thog mar go bar bya ba ni/ snying rje pad dkar las gsungs ba'i thub dbang gi smon lam lnga brgya pa sogs dang*/

byams pa lung bstan gyi mdo las gsungs pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug gi smon lam sogs gtso 'khor rang rang gi dam bca' bden tshig dpag tu med cing ngo mtshar ba rnams yid la nges nas/ de 'grub pa'i ched du nyams su blangs pa la/ spyi dang khyad par gnyis las/ dang po ni/

bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag bar rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do// skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ༈ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa dam pa'i chos skyong zhing lha mi kun gyi bsod nams kyi dpal gyi zhing du de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas bka' bsgos te mya ngan las mi 'da' bar 'jig rten na mngon sum du gzigs shing bka' lung gi rjes su bsgrubs pa 'phags pa'i tshig nges pas zhal gyis bzhes pa/ zhes pa thams cad kyi 'gor sbyar nas/ pri yang ku'i gling na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po sgra gcan zin 'khor dgra bcom pa stong chig brgyas bskor ba'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do// skyabs su mchi'o// bya rgod phung po'i ri la 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po lam phran brtan 'khor dgra bcom stong drug brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs/ sogs kun la 'gre'o// shar gyi lus 'phags gling na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po bha ra dhwa dza bsod snyoms len 'khor dgra bcom pa stong gis bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad/ lha'i gnas sum cu rtsa gsum na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po lam brtan 'khor dgra bcom pa dgu brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la/ ri'i rgyal po ngos yangs la 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po klu'i sde 'khor dgra bcom pa stong nyis brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la/ ri'i rgyal po bhi hu la 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po sbed byed 'khor dgra bcom pa stong bzhi brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i/ gangs can ri'i rgyal po la 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po mi phyed pa 'khor dgra bcom pa stong gis bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la/ gangs ri chen po ti se na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po yan lag 'byung 'khor dgra bcom pa stong sum brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la/

drang srong ri'i ngogs shel nags na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po ma pham pa 'khor dgra bcom pa brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la/ ri'i gnas kyi ngogs lo ma bdun pa zhes bya ba'i ri phug na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po nags na gnas 'khor dgra bcom pa stong bzhi brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la/ zangs gling na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po dus ldan 'khor dgra bcom pa stong chig brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la/ sing ga la'i gling na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po rdo rje mo'i bu 'khor dgra bcom pa stong gis bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la/ chu bo ya mu na'i gling na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po bzang po 'khor dgra bcom pa stong nyis brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la/ kha che'i yul na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po gser be'u 'khor dgra bcom pa lnga brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la/ nub kyi ba lang spyod na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po bha ra dhwa dza gser chen mchog 'khor dgra bcom pa bdun brgyas bskor te bzhugs= byang gi sgra mi snyan na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po ba ku la 'khor dgra bcom pa dgu brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do// skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'phags pa'i dge bsnyen dharma tā la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do// skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol// de yang phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa'i dus su mgo bo 'dud/ mchod do zhes pa'i dus su me tog 'thor/ skyabs su mchi'o zhes pa'i dus su thal mo sbyar/ byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes pa'i dus su so so'i smon lam las 'byung ba'i bde legs thams cad rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyis thob par shog snyam pa'i 'dun pa bya ba sogs bsam sbyor zung du 'brel bar bya'o// 'di ni gsol 'debs bsnyen pa zhes nyams len dngos gzhi yin pas brgya stong khri 'bum gang lcogs dang*/

tha na'ang bdun nam gsum la sogs pa nges par 'don no// de nas sngags bzla bar 'dod na/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te shākya mu na ye/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arha te samyaksaṃ budhā ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu na ye swā hā/ zhes gang 'grub dang*/ mu na ye'i rjes su/ sarba sadgha pa ri pū ra ka swā hā zhes dge 'dun 'phel ba'i sham bu'am spro na ci rigs gdags/ gnas brtan gyi mtshan sngags bzla bar 'dod na/ oṃ ārya aṅgāka rā ya swā hā/ thog mtha' kun la sbyar te/ a dzi tā ya/ ban bā swi/ kā lo dā yī/ bakkali pu trā ya/ bha drā ya/ ka na kalpat+sa ya/ bha ra dhwa dzā ya/ ba ku lā ya/ rā hu lā ya/ tsuṇṭa panthiya/ piṇṭo lā ya/ pāntha kā ya/ nā ga se nā ya/ gau pa kā ya/ a bhe dya/ oṃ arya dharma tā ya swa hā/ zhes so// de nas smon lam gdab pa dngos ni/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ston pa dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa thugs brtse ba chen pos dgongs su gsol/ khyed kyis bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol du mun par chud pa'i sems can skyob pa ma mchis pa/ skyabs ma mchis pa/ dpung gnyen ma mchis pa/ sdug bsngal gyi snod du gyur pa'i sems can rnams la thugs brtse bas dgongs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che'i snying po'i drung du smon lam chen po lnga brgya btab cing byang chub tu dam bca' bar mdzad pa de'i tshe ston pa 'khor dang bcas pas kyang snying rje chen po dang ldan pa khyod kyis smon lam btab pa legs so legs so// zhes sogs bsngags pa brjod cing khyod ni ma 'ongs pa'i dus na 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed du de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa bde bar gshegs pa 'jig rten mkhyen pa skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo bsgyur ba bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa zhes bya bar 'gyur ro// lo bzhi bcu rtsa lngas sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa de lta bu mang po dag byed par 'gyur ro// khyod mya ngan las 'das nas kyang dam pa'i chos lo stong gnas par 'gyur ro// dam pa'i chos nub nas kyang sku gdung rnams kyis smon lam btab pa de ltar 'gyur te ji skad smos pa de bzhin tu yun ring por sems can rnams 'dul bar 'gyur ro// zhes lung bstan pa de bzhin tu deng 'dir yang mtshan nas brjod de phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa 'bul na/

bdag cag la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyang sems can rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba smin par bgyid pa'i slad du/ dga' ldan gyi gnas las babs te 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i rigs su btsun mo dam pa'i mngal na gnas pa nye bar 'dzin pa la sogs pa mgon po khyod kyis btab pa'i smon lam chen po de thams cad 'grub par gyur cig / ces pa dang*/ 'phags pa sgra gcan 'dzin la sogs pa gnas brtan chen po bcu drug po re re la dgra bcom pa du mas kun nas bskor te 'tsho zhing gzhes pa dag dgongs su gsol/ dus ngan pa'i sems can las kyi sgrib pa sna tshogs kyis bsgribs pa/ nad sna tshogs kyis gzir ba mya ngan dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis gtses pa ngan song nas ngan 'gror 'og nas 'og tu ltung par 'gyur pa'i sems can rnams la thugs brtse bar dgongs te/ sngon de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa'i spyan sngar mya ngan las mi 'da' bar 'jig rten du mngon sum bzhugs shing bka' lung gi rjes su bsgrub par 'phags pa'i tshig bden pas nges par zhal gyis bzhes pa dam pa'i chos skyong zhing 'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams kyi dpal gyi zhing du gyur pa 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po bcu drug 'khor dang bcas pa'i mthu dang byin gyis brlabs kyis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis gsungs pa'i dam pa'i chos mtha' dag 'jig rten du dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig /glegs bam la bris te 'chang ba dang mchod pa dang bkur sti bgyis pa dang 'dzin pa dang klog pa dang kha ton bgyid pa dang gzhan dag la'ang rgya cher ston par gyur cig /nyan thos dang theg pa chen po'i gang zag thams cad kyang rang rang gi mdzad pa phrin las rgyas par gyur cig /rtag tu sde snod du ma nyan pa dang 'chad pa dang rtse gcig tu mos pa dang 'jig rten thams cad du bkra shis pa dang gzi byin chags pa dang bde ba dang legs pa thams cad 'byung ba dang ci bsam pa'i don thams cad 'grub par gyur cig

/ngan song nas ngan 'gro las grol te rab tu dga' ba rgyas par 'gyur ba dang rig pa'i ye shes rgyas par gyur cig /nam mkha' rnam par dag pa ltar dkar po'i yon tan thams cad rgyas par gyur cig /rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas par gyur cig /bdag dang sems can thams cad bslab pa gsum gyis mdzes par gyur cig /khyad par du yang rang rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la mchod pa sna tshogs dpag tu med pas mchod par gyur cig /lhag par yang gnas brtan chen po so so rang rang gi bden pa'i stobs kyi byin gyis brlabs pa rnams dang*/ so so'i byin rlabs kyi khyad par gyis sdig pa dang sdug bsngal zhi zhing dge ba dang bde legs 'phel ba'i phan yon ji skad gsungs pa thams cad bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gyis 'phral du thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes dang*/ rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung dang 'phags skyes po/ spyan mi bzang dang rnam thos sras la sogs pa dam pa'i chos skyong ba lha'i dge bsnyen 'khor dang bcas pa dgongs su gsol/ sngon de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa'i spyan sngar lha'i tshig bden pas 'dzam bu'i gling sogs yul rnams dang*/ grong dang lha dang mi dang skye bo'i tshogs dang*/ chos dang chos smra ba dang bcas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung zhing skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa bzhin tu phan yon ji skad gsungs pa thams cad bdag cag la sogs pa sems can thams cad kyis 'phral du thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes pa'i mthar/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs dang*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing*/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs dang*/ 'phags pa sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi kun tu spyod pa ma dag pa mi mnga' ba rnams kyis thugs dam nges pas de bzhin tu gyur cig

/ ces brjod cing me tog 'thor/ de dag ni dngos gzhi'i las rim mo// gsum pa rjes chog gi thog mar gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ ma hā yakṣa se na pa ta ye/ na mo badzra kro dhā ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ hu lu hu lu tiṣṭha tiṣṭha bandha bandha ha na ha na a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa nas/ khaṃ swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ rtsa brgyud bla ma ma lus dang*// gang dag sangs rgyas rang sangs rgyas// sangs rgyas rnams kyi nyan thos dang*// tshangs pa dang ni brgya byin dang*// 'jig rten skyong ba dbang phyug che// gnod sbyin sde dpon stobs chen dang*// 'phrog ma bu dang bcas rnams dang*// gang dag bar snang spyod pa rnams// me tog la sogs mchod pa rnams// sems can don du rnam kun gyis// rtag tu brtse bas bzhes su gsol// zhes dkon mchog dang chos skyong ba'i dge bsnyen rnams la spyir 'bul/ bye brag tu/ oṃ dhṛṣṭa raṣṭa ya/ bai ru ḍha kā ya/ birū pakṣa ya/ bai shra ba ṇā ya i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gsum gyis phul nas/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// ces pas rgyal chen gtor ma gtsang sar phul/ rigs drug gi gtor ma de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod pas byin gyis brlab ste/ 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga// skye gnas rnams pa bzhis bsdus pa'i// mkha' mnyam sems can cad la// bdud rtsi gtor ma 'di 'bul lo// na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki te oṃ sambha ra sambha ra hūm̐/ lan bdun/ rang rang sdug bsngal las grol nas// myur du sangs rgyas thob par shog / gzhi bdag gtor ma yang byin rlabs sngar ltar la/ brtan ma bcu gnyis gnod sbyin lnga// ri rab ri bdun rol mtsho sogs// 'jig rten 'dir gnas gzhi bdag dang*// khyad par yul dang grong 'di'i lha// ri dang chu klung ngam grog thang*// gnyug mar gnas pa ma lus la/
